keywords.navigate: Extra search words (space-separated) that find the navigation commands. Not shown.
keywords.language: Extra search words (space-separated) that find the language commands. Not shown.
placeholder: Hint inside the command palette's search field; ends with an ellipsis.
triggerTitle: Title on the floating button that opens the command palette and its AI assistant. Two or three words; "&" may be written out.
triggerHint: Small line under the title on desktop. {shortcut} is the keyboard shortcut (⌘K or Ctrl+K) — keep it first. "Claude" is a product name (the AI model): never translate it. "my work" is the site owner speaking.
triggerHintTouch: The same line for touch devices, without the shortcut. "Claude" is a product name: never translate it.
